name: Onward Technologies Ltd
title: Onward Technologies Ltd - 517536 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: FY26 record revenue of INR 550 crores (+10.5%) and 13.2% gross margin, but no capacity or pricing signal; management deflects AI-substitution questions and gives only double-digit guidance.

capex.quote: we would be doing, in the next two years, close to about INR 25 crores, just for existing clients, and this is more for just setting up the labs
